title: Uniform fixed-pool assignment replay repair
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The smoke audit mismatch is caused by restore_group_assignment_rng_from_evidence replaying null-weight uniform assignments through weighted random.choices instead of the trainer's native sample/randrange branch; selecting replay semantics from recorded weights plus adaptive metric evidence will exactly recover the existing immutable chain without weakening hash or membership checks.
material_change: Correct null-weight provenance replay to use native uniform assignment when no adaptive metric evidence exists, retain legacy adaptive-null compatibility, and add a regression covering pool_size smaller than group count where native randrange differs from weighted choices.
baseline: The immutable two-row smoke chain hashes pass but generic replay fails at iteration1; direct seed replay through native uniform assignment reproduces its recorded identities while weighted choices does not.
source: Existing immutable v6-soup-uniform-mixed-league-smoke assignment JSONL and train_v5 replay/audit implementation.
notes: Repair may change only read/replay semantics and tests; it must not modify the completed checkpoint, manifest, metrics, or assignment JSONL.
26 regression tests PASS. The previously immutable smoke chain now replays exactly: 2 records, tail SHA 4fbd4349..., checkpoint/manifest/metrics/assignments hashes captured, audit PASS.

result.summary: Corrected uniform fixed-pool assignment replay semantics; 26 tests passed and the existing immutable 8k smoke session now passes exact RNG/hash/membership audit.
result.conclusion: Null assignment weights are not equivalent to explicit uniform weighted choices: non-adaptive training uses sample/randrange. Metric-evidence disambiguation restores valid uniform chains while preserving compatibility with legacy adaptive-null provenance.
result.next_step: Finish the already-completed smoke from its now-valid evidence, then preregister the matched one-member versus four-member 65k mixed-opponent pilot.
